## What's new

Button Mapping, in each console's menu and in the in-game menu as Buttons:
what each of the Brick's buttons presses - any of the console's own buttons,
by the names its core gives them (a Genesis's A, B, C, X, Y, Z and Mode),
the same with turbo, or nothing. Per console, and per game over it from the
in-game menu (For: This game / All its games), applied in a game as it
changes. The consoles that had X and Y as turbo A and B start that way.

Rewind, in each console's menu, off until turned on: hold MENU+L1 in a game
to step back through the last minutes of play (ChaOS-diatom 0.7.0).

What's New, on the Updates screen, once a newer version is found: that
release's notes, which each release now carries as ChaOS-notes.txt.

About ChaOS's Awake for counts from when the Brick started, not from when the
launcher last did. The README says ChaOS is still in testing and
development, and explains button mapping and rewind; the device's Controls
page has MENU+L1.

---

ChaOS 0.9.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.9.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.9.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
